title: Giving Flowers
description: There are so many Sweet Flowers in Vanarana's garden now. Varsha would be ecstatic to see it for herself for sure.

dialogs.text: Strange, what's this kid doing here? Hey kid! Why are you here all alone?
Ah! A weird person, and a weird flying person.
Come on, that's rude!
Yeah, that's right. Rude's my middle name. Didn't even have parents to teach me "manners," don'cha know?
(There's a story behind this for sure...)
Hmm... Anyway, we aren't weird people, and we definitely aren't bad guys.
We're just a pair of kind travelers.
Exactly. And that's why we don't leave those who are troubled behind.
#Paimon's name is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. Might we know your name?
My name is Varsha...
And why are you here all alone, Varsha? We can escort you back if you're lost.
No. The past should stay in the past. I've decided to move on.
Eh?
I can't rely on adults. I must go my own way...
What's with this old-person talk...? You are just a kid! Anyway, the forest can be pretty dangerous. A kid like you isn't gonna be able to handle it.
Some bad guy tried to take me away earlier... But it's okay. I'm more careful now. I'll be able to avoid danger.
He was a guy from Vimara Village, and he looked nice enough. But as it turns out, he was no different from those adults I met before...
You almost got taken away by some bad guy!? You haven't learned your lesson at all, then! Wait, and how did you manage to get away last time, anyway?
Some small creature whisked me to this place. I've never seen something this small in Gandharva Ville, so I believe that it had to be a forest spirit.
(That should be an Aranara.)
(That said, could "that guy from Vimara Village" refer to...)
Anyway, it's still not safe for kids to be alone in the forest. You might encounter all kinds of dangers, like...
Running into dangerous Fungi.
Yeah! And villains such as Nara Marana. Ugh, no, Paimon meant to say...
You might run into bad guys that might try to kidnap you.
#Yup! What {NICKNAME} said! Or... or you might starve!
It's impossible to starve in a forest full of nature's gifts. Starshrooms, Sweet Flowers, and Mints are everywhere, and I eat like a bird anyway.
And I've always been pretty good at taking care of plants, so finding a safe place to plant some Sweet Flowers or Mints to feed myself won't be a problem.
Haha, a garden full of Sweet Flowers... Wouldn't that be paradise?
A garden full of Sweet Flowers, huh... Ooh, Paimon remembers that there were many in the garden we took care of for the Aranara!
Wait. Are you saying that there really is a paradise like that out there, Paimon?
Yup! And believe it or not, the "forest spirit" that saved you is from a species called the Aranara.
We know this, 'cause we've helped plant many Viparyas for them.
We helped the earth to remember.
That's right. According to Aranakula, Vanarana remembers everything, so the Viparyas can sprout in the garden once the land remembers them again.
...I've heard a lot of stories like this before, and only kids take them seriously. But I know you said this with good intentions, Paimon, so thank you.
Aren't you a kid as well? And Paimon's not telling stories. Paimon means it for real!
Yeah. That's what every storyteller says.
If you don't believe us... Well, seeing is believing! Come with us and see for yourself!
Wait, you've really prepared a place to fit your story? Now I'm getting curious.
Ugh, Paimon's telling you the truth...
#Let's take her to the Aranara's garden, {NICKNAME}. That should silence her doubts once and for all.
#We're looking for my lost {F#brother}{M#sister}...
Yes. So of course we got worried when we saw a little girl like you here all alone! We just can't leave you like this knowing that you might need help.

Hmm... Paimon doesn't know what she's been through, but it seems like it would be hard to convince her to return.

If bread could break in half and grow back again, no one would ever go hungry...
Hi Varsha! You're still here, huh?
#Paimon. {NICKNAME}. Good to see you. I'm doing well here. There's nothing for you to worry about.
You've persevered, huh...
Are you still trying to persuade me? I'm not going anywhere with you. Not at all...
Well... we're not gonna force you to do anything. Remember what you said about "a garden full of Sweet Flowers"?
Ah... It was a wishful thinking actually. I know there isn't such a place.
Hmm... This maturity still feels weird coming from a kid.

flow.stepDescription: Go to Vanarana's garden with Varsha

dialogs.text: Wow, there are so many Sweet Flowers!
Don't run so fast, Varsha!
The flowers are coming along very well here!
#Come on over, Paimon! You too, {NICKNAME}!
#Varsha just can't sit still for even a second... Let's go, {NICKNAME}.
#Did you prepare all this, Paimon and {NICKNAME}?
Ugh... Yes and no. It's Aranakula and Arakara who tend to this garden together. We just helped out a little on the side. It is not built just for made-up stories.
Aranakula and Arakara... They are the "Aranara," the forest spirits?
Yes! You finally believe Paimon now? Not only did we help to take care of the garden, but we also went on adventures with the Aranara!
The Aranara are the ones who take the kidnapped kids back to Vimara Village.
It's still hard to believe the stories though... But if I stay here, will I have a chance to see them too?
Vanarana is not actually dangerous, but are you sure you don't want to go back to Gandharva Ville?
You have a memory like a sieve, Paimon. I said I couldn't rely on adults and that I want to go my own way.
But...
Alright, don't worry about me. I've managed to live on my own so far, remember?
And I am a great caretaker of plants. The Aranara would be happy to see the garden flourishing here!
Well, if you insist...
You're such a worrywart, Paimon. No one has cared about me this much for as long as I can remember.
Uh... Listen here, Varsha, you are safe here in Vanarana. But you are still a kid, so please take care of yourself.
I know, I know. You two take care as well!
